sentences: If a mosquito grew to your size overnight,
you'd wake up to a two-hundred-pound bug staring at you from the end of your bed.
You'd pull the blanket over your head, but it would stab its needle right through the blanket into your arm
and suck out all your blood in one go, like juice through a straw.
As you shrivel up like a dry leaf, its belly swells up like a balloon.
Then it tries to leave through the door.
On its very first step, its legs snap like spaghetti, and it collapses, gasping for air.
That's because mosquitoes don't have lungs; their tiny air tubes can't get enough oxygen to a body that big.
And when it grows three hundred times taller, its weight goes up millions of times, but its legs don't get nearly that strong.
So it could drain you dry, but it would never even make it to the door.
